rules.title: Rules
rules.text: Each number tells you how many mines are in the eight squares around it. Uncover every square that has no mine. Your first tap is always safe. Use “Flag” (or a long press, right click or the F key) to mark suspected mines. Tap a number that already has that many flags around it to open all its other neighbours at once. The arrow keys move the focus; Enter or Space uncovers.
